rows.heading: Commercial Airplanes
rows.text: Commercial Airplanes revenue was $41,494 million in 2025, versus $22,861 million in 2024 and $33,901 million in 2023.

rows.heading: Commercial Airplanes
rows.text: BCA recorded a loss from operations of $7,079 million in 2025, an operating margin of (17.1)%.

rows.heading: Defense, Space & Security
rows.text: Defense, Space & Security revenue was $27,234 million in 2025, up from $23,918 million in 2024.

rows.heading: Defense, Space & Security
rows.text: BDS loss from operations narrowed to $128 million in 2025, a (0.5)% operating margin, from $5,413 million in 2024.

rows.heading: Global Services
rows.text: Global Services revenue was $20,923 million in 2025, up $969 million on higher government and commercial services revenue.

rows.heading: Global Services
rows.text: BGS earnings from operations were $13,474 million in 2025, a 64.4% operating margin.

rows.heading: Global Services
rows.text: BGS earnings rose $9,856 million in 2025 "primarily due to a 2025 gain on the Digital Aviation Solutions Divestiture of $9,566 million."

rows.heading: Commercial Airplanes
rows.text: BCA backlog was $567,290 million at December 31, 2025 versus $435,175 million a year earlier, within total backlog of $682,207 million.

rows.heading: Defense, Space & Security
rows.text: BDS backlog was $84,786 million at December 31, 2025 compared with $64,023 million at December 31, 2024.

rows.heading: Global Services
rows.text: BGS total backlog of $29,720 million at December 31, 2025 increased 39% from $21,403 million.

rows.heading: Commercial Airplanes
rows.text: BCA 2025 deliveries totaled 600 aircraft, including 447 737s and 88 787s, versus 348 total in 2024.
